H5775.d: flying creatures, fowl, insects, birds; fowl, birds; winged insects
s: All «fowls» that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the «birds» of the heavens were fled.
But all other «flying» creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.

H5774.d: v; to fly, fly about, fly away; (Hiphil) to cause to fly, light upon; (Hithpolel) to fly away; (Qal) to cover, be dark
s: And he rode upon a cherub, and did «fly»: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of «Eden» to dress it and to keep it.

Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and «Eden» the son of Joah:

And next him were «Eden», and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:

H5704.d: prep; as far as, even to, until, up to, while, as far as; of space; in combination; of time; of degree; until, while, to the point that, so that even
s: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew «until» he became very great:
And Moses said, Let no man leave of it «till» the morning.
And the LORD said unto Moses, How «long» refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?

H5785.d: skin, hide; skin (of men); hide (of animals)
s: The flesh also, in which, even in the «skin» thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
And the flesh and the «hide» he burnt with fire without the camp.

H5769.d: long duration, antiquity, futurity, for ever, ever, everlasting, evermore, perpetual, old, ancient, world; ancient time, long time (of past)
s: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for «ever».
Hast thou marked the «old» way which wicked men have trodden?
And in my prosperity I said, I shall «never» be moved.
And Abraham planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the «everlasting» God.

H5771.d: perversity, depravity, iniquity, guilt or punishment of iniquity; iniquity; guilt of iniquity, guilt (as great), guilt (of condition); consequence of or punishment for iniquity
s: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his «iniquity».
«Iniquities» prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
And Cain said unto the LORD, My «punishment» is greater than I can bear.

H5711.d: A woman living at the time before the Flood, first mentioned at Gen.26.34;; the 1st of the 2 wives of Lamech and mother of Jabal and Jubal; a Hittitess, 1 of the 3 wives of Esau and mother of Eliphaz; also called 'Bashemath'
s: And «Adah» bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
And «Adah» bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.

H5748.d: a musical instrument; perhaps a flute, reed-pipe, or panpipes
s: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the «organ».

H5750.d: subst; a going round, continuance; still, yet, again, besides; still, yet (of continuance or persistence); still, yet, more (of addition or repetition); again; still, moreover, besides
s: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no «more» stiffnecked.
Whilst it is «yet» in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
And he stayed yet other seven days; and «again» he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
There was a man in the land of «Uz», whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
And the children of Aram; «Uz», and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
The children of Dishan are these; «Uz», and Aran.
«Huz» his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

H5745.d: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.28

s: One «kid» of the «goats» for a sin offering:
And she put the skins of the kids of the «goats» upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a «kid».

Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my «delicates», he hath cast me out.
Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have «pleasure», my lord being old also?

H5713.d: always plural and always of laws as divine testimonies
s: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his «testimonies»:
And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a «witness» unto me, that I have digged this well.
Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and «lentiles», and parched pulse,

H5739.d: flock, herd; flock; herds, flocks and herds
s: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away «flocks», and feed thereof.
But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness «like» a «flock».
Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy «herds».

H5707.d: witness; witness, testimony, evidence (of things); witness (of people)
s: If a false «witness» rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong;
Thou shalt not «bear» false «witness» against thy neighbour.

H5763.d: to give suck, suckle, nurse; (Qal) giving suck (participle)
s: And the men did so; and took two «milch» kine, and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home:
And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was «Avith».
And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the «Adullamite», to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.

H5749.d: to bear witness; (Qal) to bear witness, say again and again; (Hophal) to protest, give warning
s: Hear, O my people, and I will «testify» unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand «upright».
A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom «strong» wrath.
A nation of «fierce» countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the «mighty» waters;
Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at «night» he shall divide the spoil.
I was eyes to the «blind», and feet was I to the lame.
We grope for the wall «like» the «blind», and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.

H5756.d: (Hiphil) to take refuge, bring to refuge, seek refuge
s: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be «brought» home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.
All the «congregation» of Israel shall keep it.
This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his «company»;

H5797.d: might, strength; material or physical; personal or social or political
s: Seek the LORD and his «strength», seek his face continually.
For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a «strong» tower from the enemy.
God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that «power» belongeth unto God.
Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the «lead»,

H5703.d: perpetuity, for ever, continuing future; ancient (of past time); for ever (of future time); for ever (of God's existence)
s: The LORD shall reign for ever and «ever».

H5736.d: to remain over, be in excess; (Hiphil) to have a surplus

s: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the «Testimony», to be kept.

And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the «tabernacle» of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

H5786.d: (Piel) to blind, make blind, put out the eyes of
s: And thou shalt take no gift: for the gift «blindeth» the wise, and perverteth the words of the righteous.
And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their «ornaments» by the mount Horeb.

H5799.d: entire removal, scapegoat; refers to the goat used for sacrifice for the sins of the people; meaning uncertain
s: And he that let go the «goat» for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

H5766.d: injustice, unrighteousness, wrong; violent deeds of injustice; injustice (of speech); injustice (generally)
s: So the poor hath hope, and «iniquity» stoppeth her mouth.
Ye shall do no «unrighteousness» in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and «blindness», and astonishment of heart:
«Blind», or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.

H5747.d: A man of Bashan living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.21.33
s: Sihon king of the Amorites, and «Og» king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

H5761.d: People who lived in modern Gaza, first mentioned at Deu.2.23; a people among the early inhabitants of Palestine located in the southwest corner of the seacoast; a city in Benjamin
s: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the «Avites»:

H5782.d: to rouse oneself, awake, awaken, incite; (Qal) to rouse oneself, awake; (Niphal) to be roused; (Polel) to stir up, rouse, incite; (Hithpolel) to be excited, be triumphant
s: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise «up» their mourning.
«Awake», why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
None is so fierce that dare «stir» him «up»: who then is able to stand before me?
The king of «Eglon», one; the king of Gezer, one;
So the children of Israel served «Eglon» the king of Moab eighteen years.
The king of Libnah, one; the king of «Adullam», one;

H5740.d: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.23.23
s: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and «Eder», and Jeremoth, three.
And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and «Eder», and Jagur,
And Sharaim, and «Adithaim», and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
«Take» counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.

H5702.d: (Niphal) to shut oneself in or off or up

H5744.d: A man of the tribe of Judah living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Rut.4.17;; son of Boaz by Ruth and the grandfather of David; a Judaite, a descendant of Jarha, the Egyptian slave of Sheshan, in the line of Jerahmeel …
s: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat «Obed»,
And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat «Obed»,
Eliel, and «Obed», and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and «Obed», Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of «Obed», and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
Their «children» also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.

H5770.d: to eye, look at; (Qal) to eye, look at
s: And Saul «eyed» David from that day and forward.

H5741.d: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.18.19
s: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul’s daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto «Adriel» the Meholathite to wife.

H5753.d: to commit iniquity, do wrong, pervert; (Qal) to do wrong, commit iniquity; (Hiphil) to commit iniquity
s: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed «iniquity», we have «done» wickedly.
I am troubled; I am bowed «down» greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

H5737.d: to be lacking, fail; (Piel) to leave lacking
s: Yea, truth «faileth»; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor «digged»; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.

H5798.d: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.6.3;; a man slain by Jehovah for touching the sacred ark; a Benjamite of the sons of Ehud; ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; the garden where kings Manasseh and Amon of Judah were buried
s: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and «Uzza» and Ahio drave the cart.
And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of «Uzza»: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
The children of «Uzza», the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, «Uzza» his son,
And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat «Uzza», and Ahihud.

H5722.d: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.8; also translated "wielded" or "raised"
s: These be the names of the mighty men whom David had: The Tachmonite that sat in the seat, chief among the captains; the same was «Adino» the Eznite: he lift up his spear against eight hundred, whom he slew at one time.

H5714.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.5.1;; father of Abinadab, an officer of Solomon; grandfather of the prophet Zechariah; a Gershonite Levite, son of Joah; a priest in the time of Nehemiah; a seer in the time of king Jeroboam of the northern kingdom of Israel …
s: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of «Iddo» the prophet, saying,
And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet «Iddo».
Ahinadab the son of «Iddo» had Mahanaim:
Joah his son, «Iddo» his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
Haran, and Canneh, and «Eden», the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.

H5718.d: A man of the tribe of Levi  living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.12;; maternal grandfather of king Josiah of Judah and native of Boscath in the lowlands of Judah; a Gershonite Levite and ancestor of Asaph; a Benjamite, son of Shimhi; a priest, son of Jehoram …
s: And «Adaiah» the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of «Adaiah» of Boscath.
The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of «Adaiah»,
And «Adaiah», and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of «Adaiah», and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

H5717.d: A man of the tribe of Simeon(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.36; a prince of the Simeon of the family of Shimei in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah; a priest, ancestor of Maasiai; ancestor of Azmaveth, the treasurer of David
s: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and «Adiel», and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of «Adiel», the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
And over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of «Adiel»: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:

H5738.d: A man of the tribe of Benjamin  living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.15;; a Benjamite, son of Beriah, chief of the inhabitants of Aijalon; also 'Eder'

H5793.d: A man of the tribe of Judah  living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at 1Ch.9.4;; son of Ammihud and a descendant of Pharez of Judah; one of the sons of Bigvai who returned from exile with the 2nd caravan with Ezra
s: «Uthai» the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
Of the sons also of Bigvai; «Uthai», and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

H5721.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.42
s: «Adina» the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,

H5734.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.20; a Manassite who deserted from Saul and joined David at Ziklag; a captain in charge of over 300,000 men of Judah in the time of Jehoshaphat
s: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, «Adnah», and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; «Adnah» the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

H5724.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.29
s: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of «Adlai»:

H5752.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ch.15.1;; father of Azariah the prophet in the reign of king Asa of Judah; a prophet of Jehovah in Samaria at the time of Pekah's invasion of Judah
s: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of «Oded»:

But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was «Oded»: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.

H5720.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.15; ancestor of a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel; a chief among the returned exiles who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
s: The children of «Adin», four hundred fifty and four.

H5705.d: prep; even to, until, up to, during; until, up to the time that, ere that
s: Thou sawest «till» that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.
Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, «until» another commandment shall be given from me.

And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he «goats», according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

H5733.d: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.30; one of the family of Pahath-moab who returned with Ezra and married a foreign wife; a priest, descendant of Harim in the days of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua
s: And of the sons of Pahath-moab; «Adna», and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.

And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and «became» fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.

H5791.d: to be bent, be crooked, bend, make crooked, pervert; (Pual) thing bent (participle); (Hithpael) to bend oneself
s: Doth God «pervert» judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and «turned» me over into the hands of the wicked.

H5767.d: unjust one, perverse one, unrighteous one
s: Surely «such» are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.

H5759.d: young male or man or boy, boy
s: Yea, «young» children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
«Deck» thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion «passed» by it.
Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul «grieved» for the poor?

H5765.d: to act wrongfully or unjustly, deviate from; (Piel) to act wrongfully
s: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal «unjustly», and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are «yet» alive.
The LORD hath «mingled» a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.

Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to «pleasures», that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
Can a woman forget her «sucking» «child», that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

H5790.d: (Qal) to hasten to, help, succour; meaning uncertain

H5708.d: menstruation; filthy rag, stained garment (fig. of best deeds of guilty people)

H5778.d: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.40.8
s: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of «Ephai» the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
How hath the Lord «covered» the daughter of Zion with a «cloud» in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt «bake» it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
The king answered and said, I know of certainty that ye would gain the «time», because ye see the thing is gone from me.

H5709.d: to pass on, pass away; (P'al); (Aphel) to take away, remove, depose
s: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it be not changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which «altereth» not.

Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became «like» the «chaff» of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.

Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and «thine» «iniquities» by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.
«While» the word was in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from heaven, saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to thee it is spoken; The kingdom is departed from thee.

H5789.d: (Qal) to lend aid, come to help, hasten

H5781.d: (Hiphil) to totter, cause to totter, crush; meaning uncertain
s: Behold, I «am» pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.

H5783.d: (Niphal) to be exposed, be bared, be laid bare
s: Thy bow was «made» quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
